package design

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"

	dsl "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/dsl"
)

func count(name string) int {
	n, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv(name))
	if err != nil || n < 0 {
		panic("set " + name + " to a non-negative integer")
	}
	return n
}

var _ = dsl.API("scaling", func() {
	dsl.Meta("http:generate", "server")
	dsl.Meta("openapi:version", "3.1")
	for i := 0; i < count("PROBE_ERRORS"); i++ {
		dsl.Error(fmt.Sprintf("failure_%d", i), dsl.ErrorResult)
	}
	dsl.HTTP(func() {
		for i := 0; i < count("PROBE_ERRORS"); i++ {
			dsl.Response(fmt.Sprintf("failure_%d", i), 400)
		}
	})
})

var _ = dsl.Service("scaling", func() {
	for i := 0; i < count("PROBE_ERRORS"); i++ {
		dsl.Error(fmt.Sprintf("failure_%d", i))
	}
	for i := 0; i < count("PROBE_METHODS"); i++ {
		dsl.Method(fmt.Sprintf("method_%d", i), func() {
			dsl.Result(dsl.String)
			dsl.HTTP(func() {
				dsl.GET(fmt.Sprintf("/method/%d", i))
			})
		})
	}
})
